accountTab.title: Account
accountTab.displayNameHint: Shown instead of your username in the UI.
accountTab.emailHint: Used for password resets and notifications.

authorizedAppsTab.title: Authorized Applications
authorizedAppsTab.description: These are third-party applications that have been granted access to your projects. You can review permissions or disconnect them at any time.
authorizedAppsTab.noAppsHint: When you authorize third-party apps to access your projects, they will appear here.
authorizedAppsTab.noGrants: No project permissions. This app has no access to any projects.

connectionTab.title: Connection Settings
connectionTab.offlineInfo: You are currently working offline. Your data is stored locally on this device.
connectionTab.localDescription: Work without a server connection. Your data will be stored locally on this device.
connectionTab.serverDescription: Connect to an Inkweld server to sync your data and collaborate with others.
connectionTab.localProjectsInfo: {{count}} local project(s) can be migrated to the server after authentication.
connectionTab.changeServerDescription: Change to a different Inkweld server.
connectionTab.loginMigrateDesc: Log in with your existing server account to migrate your local projects.
connectionTab.registerMigrateDesc: Create a new account on the server to migrate your local projects.
connectionTab.migrationSuccess: Successfully migrated {{count}} project(s) to the server.
connectionTab.switchWarning: Switching modes or servers may require you to log in again. Make sure to save any unsaved work before switching.
connectionTab.switchToLocalMessage: Switching to local mode will disconnect from the server. You will need to reconnect and log in again to access your server projects. Continue?
connectionTab.connectionFailed: Failed to connect to server. Please check the URL and try again.
connectionTab.changeServerMessage: Changing servers will disconnect you from the current server. You will need to log in again. Continue?
connectionTab.migrateMessage: You have {{count}} local project(s). {{count}} will be uploaded to the server after you authenticate. Your local data will be removed after successful migration. Continue?
connectionTab.migrationErrorsSnackbar: Migration completed with errors. {{success}} succeeded, {{failed}} failed.

projectSettingsTab.autoSaveSnapshots: Auto-save snapshots on tab close and project exit

storageSize.title: Server Storage
storageSize.unavailable: Storage size is available in server mode.

mcp.title: MCP Access
mcp.description: Connect external tools (like AI assistants) to your project via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Most tools sign in through your browser with OAuth — no API key required.
mcp.aiDisabled: AI features are disabled by the administrator.
mcp.aiDisabledDesc: MCP access is unavailable while this setting is active. Contact your administrator for more information.
mcp.endpointDesc: Add this URL to an MCP-capable tool (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, or Claude Desktop via a custom connector) as a Streamable HTTP MCP server. On first use the tool will open your browser to sign in and pick which projects to share.
mcp.legacyHint: For scripts or tools that don't support OAuth, you can create a legacy API key below instead.
mcp.legacyKeysDesc: Long-lived tokens for tools and scripts that don't support OAuth. Each key is scoped to this project only.
mcp.copyWarning: Copy this key now! It will not be shown again.
